info.name: User Service
info.description: Auth0-backed user-service API checks. Set environment variables before running: base_url, auth0_domain, auth0_audience, postman_client_id, and postman_client_secret. The collection fetches and caches an Auth0 access token for the current request's required scope.

exec: throw new Error('Set base_url before running user-service requests.');
throw new Error('Missing scoped token. Run Auth0 Tokens / Get token - ' + requiredScope + ' first.');
throw new Error('Scoped token is expired or near expiry. Rerun Auth0 Tokens / Get token - ' + requiredScope + '.');
